name: 整列頁首（大標誌置中、超出下緣）→ 捲動後縮成標誌靠左的矮頁首，側滑選單
desc: 橫跨全寬、固定在畫面頂端的頁首。頁面頂端時標誌置中且很大，下半部超出頁首；捲動後頁首變矮，標誌縮小移到左側。導覽連結全部收進從右側滑入的選單面板。
prompt: 建立一個橫跨整個畫面寬的頁首列，固定在畫面頂端：只有標誌和選單按鈕，導覽連結全部收進選單面板，內容不受頁面內容最大寬度限制，左右兩側各留約畫面寬二十分之一的邊距，隨畫面寬度伸縮。頁面頂端時，標誌水平放在畫面正中央，明顯大於頁首上的其他元素；標誌的上緣在頁首裡面，約從頁首高度的三分之一處開始，只有下半部超出頁首下緣，疊在頁首下方的內容前面；左側可放一段次要文字，沒有時省略；右側放選單按鈕，選單按鈕左邊是功能區，可放按鈕、文字連結或圖示按鈕，沒有時省略；次要文字、功能區與選單按鈕在同一水平線上垂直置中。捲動約一個畫面高度後，頁首改變排列並變矮：標誌縮小、移到左側並完整落在頁首內，次要文字隱藏，功能區與選單按鈕仍在右側；之後一直固定到頁面最下方，往下或往上捲動都不隱藏。點選單按鈕後，選單面板從畫面右側滑入，約佔畫面寬的三成，面板以外的頁面變暗，面板右上角有關閉按鈕；面板上半部是一組直向排列的大連結，每項左側可放小圖示、右側有箭頭，項目之間有分隔線；下方是一欄直向排列的小型文字連結，同一高度的右側可放一排小圖示連結，沒有時省略。
mobile: 頁首仍是整列：標誌改為靠左，仍然明顯大於其他元素；標誌的上緣在頁首裡面，和右側的元素在同一列，只有下半部超出頁首下緣，疊在頁首下方的內容前面；次要文字不放在頁首上；右側留選單按鈕，功能區只保留文字連結與圖示按鈕，按鈕移出頁首。捲動後標誌縮小並完整落在頁首內，位置仍靠左，其他元素不變；往下或往上捲動都不隱藏。點選單按鈕後，選單面板從畫面右側滑入，幾乎佔滿畫面寬，只在左側露出一小條頁面，面板右上角有關閉按鈕；面板內容的排法和桌機相同：直向排列的大連結與分隔線在上，小型文字連結一欄在下，右側可放一排小圖示連結。

en.name: Full-width header (large centered logo overflowing its bottom edge) → shrinks to a shorter header with the logo on the left after scrolling, slide-in menu
en.desc: A full-width header fixed to the top of the viewport. At the top of the page the logo is centered and very large, its lower half extending past the header; after scrolling the header gets shorter and the logo shrinks and moves to the left. All navigation links live in a menu panel that slides in from the right.
en.prompt: Create a header bar spanning the full width of the viewport, fixed to the top of the viewport, with only the logo and a menu button, with all navigation links inside the menu panel; the content is not limited to the maximum page content width, keeping a margin of about one twentieth of the viewport width on the left and right that scales with the viewport. At the top of the page, the logo sits horizontally at the exact center of the viewport and is clearly larger than the other elements in the header; the top edge of the logo is inside the header, starting about one third of the way down the header height, and only its lower half extends past the bottom edge of the header, sitting in front of the content below the header. Optionally place a short piece of secondary text on the left; omit it when there is no content. The menu button sits on the right, with the actions group to its left, which can hold a button, a text link or icon buttons and is omitted when empty; the secondary text, the actions group and the menu button are vertically centered on the same horizontal line. After scrolling about one viewport height, the header changes its arrangement and gets shorter: the logo shrinks, moves to the left and fits entirely inside the header, the secondary text is hidden, and the actions group and the menu button stay on the right; from then on the header stays fixed until the bottom of the page and never hides, whether scrolling down or up. Clicking the menu button slides a menu panel in from the right side of the viewport, about three tenths of the viewport width, dimming the page outside the panel, with a close button in the top-right corner of the panel. The upper part of the panel is a vertical list of large links, each with an optional small icon on the left and an arrow on the right, with dividers between the items; below it is a single column of small text links, and at the same height on the right you may place a row of small icon links, omitted when there is no content.
en.mobile: The header stays a full-width bar: the logo moves to the left and is still clearly larger than the other elements; the top edge of the logo is inside the header, on the same row as the elements on the right, and only its lower half extends past the bottom edge of the header, sitting in front of the content below the header; the secondary text is not placed in the header; the menu button stays on the right, and the actions group keeps only the text link and icon buttons, with the button moved out of the header. After scrolling, the logo shrinks and fits entirely inside the header, still on the left, with the other elements unchanged; the header never hides, whether scrolling down or up. Tapping the menu button slides a menu panel in from the right side of the viewport, covering almost the full width and leaving only a narrow strip of the page visible on the left, with a close button in the top-right corner of the panel; the panel content is arranged as on desktop: the vertical list of large links with dividers on top, a single column of small text links below, and an optional row of small icon links on the right.
